verdict.rationale: Region or residency selection is a fair question for a hosted media relay service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows users can choose where relay data is stored or processed. Per-relay isolated scopes are about tenant separation, not geography, and a community mention of a 'global' CDN map does not show any user-selectable region.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
